title: Cute and a perfect place to store stuff animals.
text: Cute and a perfect place to store stuff animals.. This is great!  We were able to put all of his stuffed animals in the bean bag and still had plenty of room.  It's not very comfortable to sit on after, but they are all stored in a neat place that can be used as a seat.  A few more animals might make it more comfortable. Love the color!

product_metadata.title: DII Keeping Score Stripes Print, Large Bean Bag Chair Cover for Kids & Stuffed Animal Storage, Aqua, One Size
features: LARGE SIZE - Measures 38" Diameter and 22" Tall. Can fit up to 100 stuffed animals depending on their size (stuffed animals not included).

FUN STORAGE OPTION - A creative way to store all those stuffed animals. Your kids will enjoy picking up their room with this fun bean bag, once the toys are stowed away, the stuffed bean bag becomes a fun thing to jump or lounge on.
DÉCOR PIECE - Becomes a cute piece of bedroom or playroom furniture. This adorable pattern and fun color will give kids a place to sit and read, relax, or quickly pickup their room.
SOLID CONSTRUCTION - Made of 100% Polyester, with a sturdy pull handle and a zipper that is overlapped by fabric for filling. Machine wash cold and line dry.
MORE STORAGE OPTIONS - DII offers delightful home & kitchen products including a large selection of table linens, aprons, and dishtowels.
description: Do your kids have way too many stuffed animals? Are they everywhere and you're just not sure what to do about them? Well, now there is an answer, these large bean bag covers are the perfect solution. Not only will they give you a place to store the rowdy animals but your kids will enjoy the cleanup too! Once they're securely inside the bean bag cover and it is zipped up they now have an extra place to play or lounge.
